questions.question: Which of the following techniques is used to directly observe stacking faults at the atomic scale in FCC alloys?

What does the term ΔG<sup>γ->ε</sup><sub>i</sub> mean in the context of thermodynamic calculations of SFE?

answers.a: The magnetic contribution to Gibbs free energy
answers.b: The interfacial energy of the γ/ε interface
answers.c: The Gibbs free energy difference between the FCC and HCP matrix
answers.d: The mean square strain in the <111> direction
